title: HDT os-releases.yaml
description: The operating system releases a Windows update can be filed under. The list exists because a .msu does not say which product it is for: the Windows 11 24H2 and Windows Server 2025 cumulative updates share a file-name shape, a Product of Desktop, an architecture and the build 26100, so the administrator names the release at import.

id.description: The key an imported update records.

name.description: What the console shows. Defaults to the id.

build.description: The major build, e.g. 26100. OPTIONAL ON PURPOSE: a release whose build has not been read off real media omits the key rather than guessing, because a wrong build silently refuses every correct import filed under it.

branch.description: The expected servicing branch token - ge_release for general availability, lt_release for LTSC and Server. Recorded and warned on, never matched: it is an undocumented Microsoft build-branch string.

verified.description: Whether the build number was read off real media or a real package. A release cannot be verified without a build.

note.description: Why, in one line - which media or which package the build was read from.
